sn56.48:1.1: seyyathāpi bhikkhave ayaṃ mahāpaṭhavī ekodikā assa
sn56.48:1.3: tamenaṃ puratthimo vāto pacchimena saṃhareyya pacchimo vāto puratthimena saṃhareyya uttaro vāto dakkhiṇena saṃhareyya dakkhiṇo vāto uttarena saṃhareyya
sn56.48:1.4: tatrassa kāṇo kacchapo so vassasatassa vassasatassa accayena sakiṃ sakiṃ ummujjeyya.
sn56.48:1.6: api nu kho kāṇo kacchapo vassasatassa vassasatassa accayena sakiṃ sakiṃ ummujjanto amusmiṃ ekacchiggaḷe yuge gīvaṃ paveseyyāti.
sn56.48:1.7: adhiccamidaṃ bhante yaṃ so kāṇo kacchapo vassasatassa vassasatassa accayena sakiṃ sakiṃ ummujjanto amusmiṃ ekacchiggaḷe yuge gīvaṃ paveseyyāti.
sn56.48:2.1: evaṃ adhiccamidaṃ bhikkhave yaṃ manussattaṃ labhati.
sn56.48:2.2: evaṃ adhiccamidaṃ bhikkhave yaṃ tathāgato loke uppajjati arahaṃ sammāsambuddho.
sn56.48:2.3: evaṃ adhiccamidaṃ bhikkhave yaṃ tathāgatappavedito dhammavinayo loke dippati.
sn56.48:2.4: tassidaṃ bhikkhave manussattaṃ laddhaṃ tathāgato ca loke uppanno arahaṃ sammāsambuddho tathāgatappavedito ca dhammavinayo loke dippati.
sn56.48:3.1: tasmā tiha bhikkhave idaṃ dukkhanti yogo karaṇīyo …pe… ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadāti yogo karaṇīyoti.
